scripts.build: pnpm --filter @skyhop/shared build && pnpm --filter @skyhop/game-core build && pnpm --filter @skyhop/database build && pnpm --filter @skyhop/api build && pnpm --filter @skyhop/web build
scripts.vercel:build: pnpm run build && sh -c 'if [ -n "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then pnpm db:migrate:deploy && pnpm db:seed; else echo "Skipping DB migrate/seed: DATABASE_URL not set"; fi'
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @skyhop/game-core test && pnpm --filter @skyhop/api test && pnpm --filter @skyhop/web test
